title: Nice... Nice... not THRILLING.. but nice.
text:
Nice... Nice... not THRILLING.. but nice.. It works. However, wires get tangled REALLY easily with how they place the USB ports on top of the unit, so it winds up getting dragged around.

When you set the alarm, you have to RESET it each time, starting at 6AM each time and turning the dial until you find the time you want. A little inconvenient if you want something that is going to act as an alarm clock.

If you just want to use it as a desk clock or nightstand clock and charge up your phone (which will act as your alarm clock) it will work out well.

description: CubieWink is the latest addition to the wildly popular Cubie product line of single day alarm clocks. Petite in size, Wink is powerfully packed with 2 USB’s ready to take on the task of charging cell phones and tablets. Perfect for the bedroom where there is accessible power outlets at the nightstand but no access to USB ports. You will love the convenience of plugging in at the bedside while hoteliers will appreciate the small 3.5” footprint, perfectly scaled for the ever-shrinking nightstand.
